value.doc: The producing rule: `<Module>.<rule>`, as listed by the model (e.g. `Lcr.Hqla.hqlaAmount`).

Decoration schema: for a field of a calculation record (such as the LCR calculation), the
policy rule that produces its value, by name (`Lcr.Hqla.hqlaAmount`). The field is then filled
from that rule's result when the calculation runs, rather than reported. Fields without it are
reported inputs. Values live in `calculated-from.json`, keyed by the field's node ID
(`<Package>:<Module>:<typeName>.type#<fieldName>`).

Decoration schema: the business description of a model element that has no doc comment of
its own, such as a record field ("Contract APR: the annual rate in the cardholder agreement,
in percent") or a case of a choice ("Active duty: verified active military service"). Values
live in `descriptions.json`, keyed by Morphir node ID; fields and cases use child node IDs
(`<Package>:<Module>:<typeName>.type#<fieldOrCaseName>`).

Decoration schema: the business domain that owns a policy entity ("Liquidity Risk",
"Consumer Cards"), as the SME names it. Its tables, views, rules and metrics are placed in that
domain in the catalog, and grouped into the domain's data product. Values live in
`domains.json`, keyed by the entity type's node ID (`<Package>:<Module>:<typeName>.type`).
All sections a type or rule derives from, most specific first.

One specification section. `url` is project-relative for downloaded specs
(`specs/<file>.md#<heading-anchor>`) or absolute otherwise. `section` is the section's
identifier and title as it appears in the spec, e.g. "O.D.1: Transactional Accounts".

Decoration schema: links a Morphir type or rule to the specification sections it was
derived from. Values live in `spec-links.json`, keyed by Morphir node ID.
